jp: \t\t古代文字の書かれた石。使用すると、この世界ではないどこかの入り口が開くとされている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古代文字の書かれた石。使用すると、この世界ではないどこかの入り口が開くとされている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Stone with ancient letters written on it. When used, it is said to open a gateway to another world. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Stone with ancient letters written on it. When used, it is said to open a gateway to another world. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una pietra con sopra scritti caratteri antichi. A usarla, dicono, si apre l'ingresso di un posto che non sta in questo mondo. \n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t富の象徴を模った派手に輝く黄金の像。家に何個も置いていると、久々に来た友人から成金呼ばわりされるという。\n#～嘘と勘違いされる全くの作り話・第２巻～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t富の象徴を模った派手に輝く黄金の像。家に何個も置いていると、久々に来た友人から成金呼ばわりされるという。\n#～嘘と勘違いされる全くの作り話・第２巻～\n"
en: A flashy shiny golden statue representing a symbol of wealth. It is said that if you have several of them in your house, your friends will call you a parvenu. \n# ~Totally Made-up Stories that are Mistaken for Lies, Volume 2~
en_grezzo: "A flashy shiny golden statue representing a symbol of wealth. It is said that if you have several of them in your house, your friends will call you a parvenu. \n# ~Totally Made-up Stories that are Mistaken for Lies, Volume 2~"
it: Una statua d'oro dal luccichio vistoso, fatta a immagine della ricchezza. A tenerne in casa parecchie, dicono, l'amico che torna dopo tanto ti dà del nuovo ricco. \n# ~Storie Inventate Scambiate per Bugie, Volume 2~

jp: \t\t黄金の円柱に草花をあしらった煌びやかな芸術品。細やかな彫刻もさることながら、その素材故、夜になると周囲の光を浴びて尚一層輝くという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t黄金の円柱に草花をあしらった煌びやかな芸術品。細やかな彫刻もさることながら、その素材故、夜になると周囲の光を浴びて尚一層輝くという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Golden columns decorated with flowers and grasses are a glittering work of art. In addition to the detailed carvings, the material used for the sculpture is said to shine even more brightly at night when bathed in ambient light. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Golden columns decorated with flowers and grasses are a glittering work of art. In addition to the detailed carvings, the material used for the sculpture is said to shine even more brightly at night when bathed in ambient light. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un'opera d'arte sfolgorante: una colonna d'oro guarnita di erbe e fiori. Belli gli intagli minuti, ma è il materiale che conta: di notte, dicono, prende la luce intorno e brilla ancora di più. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t王が座る為だけに作られた立派な椅子。量産性は考えていないので、贅を極めた作りとなっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t王が座る為だけに作られた立派な椅子。量産性は考えていないので、贅を極めた作りとなっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A magnificent chair made only for the king to sit on. Since it is not intended for mass production, it is made with the utmost luxury. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A magnificent chair made only for the king to sit on. Since it is not intended for mass production, it is made with the utmost luxury. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una sedia magnifica, fatta perché ci si sieda il re e nessun altro. Nessuno ha pensato a produrla in serie, e così è lavorata con ogni lusso. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t物が載せられているテーブル。大きさからするとテーブルというより机といった方が正しいだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t物が載せられているテーブル。大きさからするとテーブルというより机といった方が正しいだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A magnificent chair made only for the king to sit on. Since it is not intended for mass production, it is made with the utmost luxury. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A magnificent chair made only for the king to sit on. Since it is not intended for mass production, it is made with the utmost luxury. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo con sopra della roba. A giudicare dalla grandezza, più che un tavolo sarebbe giusto chiamarlo scrivania. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t最新モデルの美しい織物。非常にデリケートにできているので、試着することすらできない。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t最新モデルの美しい織物。非常にデリケートにできているので、試着することすらできない。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n"
en: Beautiful garment of the latest model. It is very delicately made and cannot even be tried on. \n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~
en_grezzo: "Beautiful garment of the latest model. It is very delicately made and cannot even be tried on. \n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~"
it: Un bel tessuto dell'ultimo modello. È fatto in modo così delicato che non lo si può nemmeno provare. \n# ~Palmia: Collezione Autunno-Inverno~

jp: \t\t威光を感じさせる調度品。霊験あらたかな為か、はたまた毎日磨かれているせいか。それは夜、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t威光を感じさせる調度品。霊験あらたかな為か、はたまた毎日磨かれているせいか。それは夜、周囲を明るく照らす。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: The furnishings exude prestige. Perhaps it is because of its spiritual significance, or perhaps it is because it is polished every day. It lights up the surroundings at night. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "The furnishings exude prestige. Perhaps it is because of its spiritual significance, or perhaps it is because it is polished every day. It lights up the surroundings at night. \n# ~Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una suppellettile da cui si sente la maestà. Sarà la sua virtù miracolosa, o forse che la lucidano ogni giorno: di notte fa una luce viva tutto intorno. \n# ~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t長方形の黒い箱のような鍵盤楽器。グランドピアノより軽くはあるが、それでもなお余りある重量を誇るので長旅には適さないだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t長方形の黒い箱のような鍵盤楽器。グランドピアノより軽くはあるが、それでもなお余りある重量を誇るので長旅には適さないだろう。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: Rectangular black box-like keyboard instrument. It is lighter than a grand piano, but still heavy enough to be suitable for long trips. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~
en_grezzo: "Rectangular black box-like keyboard instrument. It is lighter than a grand piano, but still heavy enough to be suitable for long trips. \n# ~Music of the Melodious Irva~"
it: Uno strumento a tasti che pare una scatola nera rettangolare. È più leggero del pianoforte a coda, ma pesa comunque anche troppo, e per un viaggio lungo non va bene. \n# ~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t固い材質で作られた横長の椅子。屋外に設置されてあると、稀にその上で昼寝をしている者がいるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t固い材質で作られた横長の椅子。屋外に設置されてあると、稀にその上で昼寝をしている者がいるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A horizontal chair made of hard material. When placed outdoors, it is said that on rare occasions some people take a nap on it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A horizontal chair made of hard material. When placed outdoors, it is said that on rare occasions some people take a nap on it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una sedia lunga di traverso, fatta di materiale duro. Quando ne mettono una all'aperto, dicono, ogni tanto ci si trova qualcuno che ci schiaccia un pisolino. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t機能美を究極までに追求した棚。無駄な機能が一切ついていない、実に潔い家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機能美を究極までに追求した棚。無駄な機能が一切ついていない、実に潔い家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This shelf is the ultimate pursuit of functional beauty. It is a truly elegant piece of furniture with no unnecessary functions. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This shelf is the ultimate pursuit of functional beauty. It is a truly elegant piece of furniture with no unnecessary functions. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale che insegue fino in fondo la bellezza dell'utile. Non ha nemmeno una funzione di troppo: un mobile di una nettezza esemplare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t手が沈みこむほど柔らかい寝具。程良く沈み込むベッドに、太陽の匂い一杯の掛け布団が合わさると、まるで自分が赤ん坊の頃に戻ったかのような奇妙な感覚に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手が沈みこむほど柔らかい寝具。程良く沈み込むベッドに、太陽の匂い一杯の掛け布団が合わさると、まるで自分が赤ん坊の頃に戻ったかのような奇妙な感覚に包まれるという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bedding is so soft that one's hands sink into it, and when the bedding is just right and the quilt is full of the smell of the sun, one is enveloped in a strange sensation as if one were a baby again. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bedding is so soft that one's hands sink into it, and when the bedding is just right and the quilt is full of the smell of the sun, one is enveloped in a strange sensation as if one were a baby again. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio così morbido che la mano ci affonda. Quando il letto che cede al punto giusto si unisce a una coperta piena di odore di sole, dicono, ti prende una sensazione strana, come di essere tornato neonato. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t光り輝く小さな祭壇。どちらかというと調度品的要素が強い為、捧げ物をすることはできないようだ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t光り輝く小さな祭壇。どちらかというと調度品的要素が強い為、捧げ物をすることはできないようだ。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Small altar shining brightly. Since it is more of a furnishing element, it does not seem to be able to accommodate offerings. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Small altar shining brightly. Since it is more of a furnishing element, it does not seem to be able to accommodate offerings. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un piccolo altare che risplende. Conta più come suppellettile che come altare, e infatti pare che non ci si possano fare offerte. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t通常のものより大きく作られた食器棚。主に沢山の客を呼んでパーティーを開く貴族の為の家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t通常のものより大きく作られた食器棚。主に沢山の客を呼んでパーティーを開く貴族の為の家具だ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cupboard made larger than usual. It is mainly a piece of furniture for nobles who host parties with many guests. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cupboard made larger than usual. It is mainly a piece of furniture for nobles who host parties with many guests. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una credenza fatta più grande del solito. È un mobile pensato per i nobili, che invitano molta gente e danno feste. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t機能美を極端にまで追求した鏡台。鏡が付いていればそれでいい、そう思わせる程思い切った家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t機能美を極端にまで追求した鏡台。鏡が付いていればそれでいい、そう思わせる程思い切った家具である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A mirror stand that pursues functional beauty to the extreme. It is a piece of furniture that is so drastic that it makes one think that a mirror is all that is needed. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A mirror stand that pursues functional beauty to the extreme. It is a piece of furniture that is so drastic that it makes one think that a mirror is all that is needed. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una toeletta che insegue all'estremo la bellezza dell'utile. Un mobile così risoluto da far pensare che basti lo specchio e nient'altro. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t埃一つない清潔な棚。数年間はこの状態が続くと評判の為、無精な客が良く買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t埃一つない清潔な棚。数年間はこの状態が続くと評判の為、無精な客が良く買っていくという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Clean, dust-free shelves. They are often bought by indolent customers because of their reputation for staying this way for several years. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Clean, dust-free shelves. They are often bought by indolent customers because of their reputation for staying this way for several years. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale pulito, senza un granello di polvere. Ha fama di restare così per anni, e per questo, dicono, lo compra spesso il cliente pigro. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t芸術的意図からあえて凹凸の付けられた机。その特性上精密な作業には不向きだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t芸術的意図からあえて凹凸の付けられた机。その特性上精密な作業には不向きだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This is a desk with an uneven surface for artistic purposes. Due to its characteristics, it is not suitable for precision work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This is a desk with an uneven surface for artistic purposes. Due to its characteristics, it is not suitable for precision work. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo a cui hanno dato apposta un piano tutto gobbe, per un'intenzione d'arte. Fatto così, per il lavoro di precisione non va. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t必要最低限の機能のみ備えた寝具。寝るというより目を瞑って時間を過ごす為に用いられる、とまで評されるこのベッドを使っても、余り疲れは取れないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t必要最低限の機能のみ備えた寝具。寝るというより目を瞑って時間を過ごす為に用いられる、とまで評されるこのベッドを使っても、余り疲れは取れないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Bedding with only the bare minimum of functionality. Even if you use this bed, which is said to be used for meditation rather than sleeping, you will probably not get very fatigued. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Bedding with only the bare minimum of functionality. Even if you use this bed, which is said to be used for meditation rather than sleeping, you will probably not get very fatigued. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio con il minimo indispensabile e nient'altro. C'è chi dice che serva più a passare il tempo a occhi chiusi che a dormire, e infatti a usarlo la stanchezza non se ne va granché. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t収まった書物さえ曰くありげに感じる程古くなった本棚。独特の傷み具合が古美術好きにはたまらなくいいのだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t収まった書物さえ曰くありげに感じる程古くなった本棚。独特の傷み具合が古美術好きにはたまらなくいいのだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bookshelves are so old that even the books in them seem to have a certain charm. The unique damage to the bookshelf is said to be irresistible to antique lovers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bookshelves are so old that even the books in them seem to have a certain charm. The unique damage to the bookshelf is said to be irresistible to antique lovers. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una libreria tanto vecchia che perfino i libri dentro sembrano avere una storia. Quel modo tutto suo di essersi rovinata, dicono, manda in visibilio chi ama le cose antiche. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tどことなく懐かしい雰囲気を感じる棚。その肌触りは幼少の頃、確かに触れた木の温もりに似ている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tどことなく懐かしい雰囲気を感じる棚。その肌触りは幼少の頃、確かに触れた木の温もりに似ている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The shelf has a somehow nostalgic atmosphere. Its texture resembles the warmth of wood that I certainly touched as a child. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The shelf has a somehow nostalgic atmosphere. Its texture resembles the warmth of wood that I certainly touched as a child. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale che ha addosso, chissà da dove, un'aria di cose passate. Al tatto somiglia al tepore del legno che da bambini si è toccato di sicuro. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t青々と茂った葉が目立つ鉢植え。真横に伸びた瑞々しい葉は、実に生命力に溢れている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t青々と茂った葉が目立つ鉢植え。真横に伸びた瑞々しい葉は、実に生命力に溢れている。\n#～ティリス園芸図鑑～\n"
en: Potted plant stands out for its lush foliage. The lush foliage growing sideways is truly full of vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~
en_grezzo: "Potted plant stands out for its lush foliage. The lush foliage growing sideways is truly full of vitality. \n# ~Illustrated Guide to Tyris Horticulture~"
it: Una pianta in vaso che si fa notare per il fogliame folto e verdissimo. Le foglie tenere, allungate proprio di lato, traboccano davvero di vita. \n# ~Atlante Illustrato del Giardinaggio di Tyris~

jp: \t\t狙った位置に矢を刺して楽しむ遊技台。投擲の腕が上がったかどうか、腕試し代わりに遊んで行く冒険者もいるのだとか。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t狙った位置に矢を刺して楽しむ遊技台。投擲の腕が上がったかどうか、腕試し代わりに遊んで行く冒険者もいるのだとか。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: A game table where you can enjoy throwing darts at the target. Some adventurers play with it to see if their throwing skills have improved. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "A game table where you can enjoy throwing darts at the target. Some adventurers play with it to see if their throwing skills have improved. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un tavolo da gioco dove ci si diverte a piantare la freccetta dove si mira. Pare che qualche avventuriero ci giochi per mettersi alla prova e vedere se è migliorato nel lancio. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t絵柄を揃えて楽しむ遊技台。３つの枠に７が揃った時、天から謎の奇声が轟くという伝説があるらしい。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t絵柄を揃えて楽しむ遊技台。３つの枠に７が揃った時、天から謎の奇声が轟くという伝説があるらしい。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: Legend has it that when a seven appears in any of the three frames, a mysterious voice is heard from the heavens. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "Legend has it that when a seven appears in any of the three frames, a mysterious voice is heard from the heavens. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un tavolo da gioco dove ci si diverte a far combaciare le figure. Pare ci sia una leggenda: quando nei tre riquadri escono tre sette, dal cielo rimbomba uno strano grido che nessuno sa spiegare. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t様々な大人の遊びが楽しめる遊技台。何でもできると謳っているが、店員は頑としてブラックジャックしかさせてくれない。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な大人の遊びが楽しめる遊技台。何でもできると謳っているが、店員は頑としてブラックジャックしかさせてくれない。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: This is an amusement table where you can enjoy a variety of grown-up games. It claims to be able to do everything, but the staff is stubborn and will only let you play blackjack. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "This is an amusement table where you can enjoy a variety of grown-up games. It claims to be able to do everything, but the staff is stubborn and will only let you play blackjack. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un tavolo da gioco con ogni sorta di svaghi da adulti. Si vanta che ci si può fare di tutto, ma il commesso non demorde e ti lascia giocare solo a blackjack. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t小さな金属球を用いる遊技台。一人でも少しの時間で遊べるが、ついつい熱が入りすぎて気づいたら夜だった、ということもあるらしい。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t小さな金属球を用いる遊技台。一人でも少しの時間で遊べるが、ついつい熱が入りすぎて気づいたら夜だった、ということもあるらしい。\n#～遊技大典・全年齢対応版～\n"
en: An amusement table that uses a small metal ball. It can be played by a single person in a short time, but it is said that sometimes people get too absorbed in the game and find that it is nighttime before they realize it. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~
en_grezzo: "An amusement table that uses a small metal ball. It can be played by a single person in a short time, but it is said that sometimes people get too absorbed in the game and find that it is nighttime before they realize it. \n# ~Game Tricks, All Ages Version~"
it: Un tavolo da gioco che va a palline di metallo. Ci si gioca anche da soli e in poco tempo, ma pare che a volte ci si scaldi troppo e ci si accorga solo dopo che è venuta notte. \n# ~Grande Compendio dei Giochi: Per Tutte le Età~

jp: \t\t湯を貯め、浸かることで体を癒す家具。そこに泡を浮かべて楽しむのが貴族達の間で流行っているそうだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t湯を貯め、浸かることで体を癒す家具。そこに泡を浮かべて楽しむのが貴族達の間で流行っているそうだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Furniture that stores hot water and heals the body by soaking. Floating bubbles in it is said to be popular among aristocrats. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Furniture that stores hot water and heals the body by soaking. Floating bubbles in it is said to be popular among aristocrats. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un mobile che si riempie d'acqua calda e cura il corpo di chi ci si immerge. Fra i nobili, pare, va di moda farci galleggiare sopra la schiuma. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tシーツの裾までパリッとした寝具。その清潔さは、しばしば白き癒し手になぞらえて売られるほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tシーツの裾までパリッとした寝具。その清潔さは、しばしば白き癒し手になぞらえて売られるほどだという。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bedding is crisp right down to the hem of the sheets. Its cleanliness is often likened to that of a white healer and sold as such. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bedding is crisp right down to the hem of the sheets. Its cleanliness is often likened to that of a white healer and sold as such. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio ben teso fin sull'orlo del lenzuolo. È così pulito che spesso, dicono, per venderlo lo paragonano alla bianca guaritrice. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t世間一般に用いられる鏡台。基本的に装飾の多さで価値が決まる家具なので、機能的にはこれでも申し分ないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t世間一般に用いられる鏡台。基本的に装飾の多さで価値が決まる家具なので、機能的にはこれでも申し分ないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A mirror stand used by the public. This is basically a piece of furniture whose value is determined by the amount of decoration, so it would be perfect in terms of functionality. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A mirror stand used by the public. This is basically a piece of furniture whose value is determined by the amount of decoration, so it would be perfect in terms of functionality. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una toeletta di quelle che usano tutti. È un mobile il cui valore si misura in fondo su quanti ornamenti porta, e quanto a servire allo scopo questa non ha niente da farsi perdonare. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t簡素な作りをしている棚。お手頃な価格なので、一人で生活しているならばこの位で十分だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t簡素な作りをしている棚。お手頃な価格なので、一人で生活しているならばこの位で十分だろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The shelves are simply made. It is reasonably priced, so if you are living alone, this is probably enough. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The shelves are simply made. It is reasonably priced, so if you are living alone, this is probably enough. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale di fattura spartana. Costa poco, e per chi vive da solo tanto basta. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t目に優しい色彩が気分を落ち着かせる寝具。余計な機能が一切ないシンプルなベッドなので、意外と男性人気も高いようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t目に優しい色彩が気分を落ち着かせる寝具。余計な機能が一切ないシンプルなベッドなので、意外と男性人気も高いようだ。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bedding's soothing colors are easy on the eyes. The bed is simple, with no superfluous features, so it seems to be surprisingly popular with men as well. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bedding's soothing colors are easy on the eyes. The bed is simple, with no superfluous features, so it seems to be surprisingly popular with men as well. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio dai colori riposanti, che calmano l'animo. È un letto semplice, senza una funzione di troppo, e forse per questo pare piaccia molto anche agli uomini. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t鋭い刃で食品を破砕する優れた調理器具。かつてパルミアにおいて非常に高価なこの器具を売る為に、少々わざとらしい寸劇を交える２人組の商人がいたらしい。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t鋭い刃で食品を破砕する優れた調理器具。かつてパルミアにおいて非常に高価なこの器具を売る為に、少々わざとらしい寸劇を交える２人組の商人がいたらしい。\n#～料理を支える脇役達～\n"
en: An excellent cooking utensil that crushes food with its sharp blade. It is said that there used to be a pair of merchants in Palmia who would put on somewhat deliberate skits in order to sell these extremely expensive utensils. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~
en_grezzo: "An excellent cooking utensil that crushes food with its sharp blade. It is said that there used to be a pair of merchants in Palmia who would put on somewhat deliberate skits in order to sell these extremely expensive utensils. \n# ~Supporting Roles in Kitchen~"
it: Un ottimo arnese da cucina che sminuzza i cibi con lame affilate. A Palmia, un tempo, pare ci fosse una coppia di mercanti che per vendere questo arnese carissimo si metteva a recitare una scenetta un po' finta. \n# ~I Comprimari della Cucina~

jp: \t\t生ある者は本来用いない寝具。少なくとも雨風はしのげるので、仕方なく使用する冒険者もいるようだ。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生ある者は本来用いない寝具。少なくとも雨風はしのげるので、仕方なく使用する冒険者もいるようだ。\n#～死にゆく者へ贈る書～\n"
en: Bedclothes that are not normally used by living people. Some adventurers seem to have no choice but to use it because it at least shelters them from the wind and rain. \n#~ Book for the Dying Ones~
en_grezzo: "Bedclothes that are not normally used by living people. Some adventurers seem to have no choice but to use it because it at least shelters them from the wind and rain. \n#~ Book for the Dying Ones~"
it: Un giaciglio che chi è vivo di regola non usa. Almeno ripara dalla pioggia e dal vento, e pare che qualche avventuriero, non avendo di meglio, ci si adatti. \n#~Libro in Dono a Chi Sta Morendo~

jp: \t\t「寝具にしておくには勿体ない程とっても硬くて、入っていればどの方向からも攻撃を寄せ付けません。難点は、攻撃する時にそこから出なければいけない所でしょうか」\n#～見習い騎士『アインク』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「寝具にしておくには勿体ない程とっても硬くて、入っていればどの方向からも攻撃を寄せ付けません。難点は、攻撃する時にそこから出なければいけない所でしょうか」\n#～見習い騎士『アインク』の言葉～\n"
en: \"It is too hard to be used as bedding, and it's sturdy enough to withstand attack from any direction. The only drawback is that you have to get out of it somehow.\" \n# ~words of <Ainc> the novice knight~
en_grezzo: "\"It is too hard to be used as bedding, and it's sturdy enough to withstand attack from any direction. The only drawback is that you have to get out of it somehow.\" \n# ~words of <Ainc> the novice knight~"
it: \"È così duro che tenerlo per giaciglio è quasi uno spreco, e finché ci stai dentro non ti arriva un colpo da nessuna parte. Il difetto, semmai, è che per colpire devi uscirne\" \n# ~Parole di <Ainc> il cavaliere novizio~

jp: \t\t所々ガタが来ている寝具。横になるだけでギシギシうるさいので、神経質な人は寝ることができないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t所々ガタが来ている寝具。横になるだけでギシギシうるさいので、神経質な人は寝ることができないだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: This bedding is rattling in places. Just lying on the bed is noisy and noisy, so people with nervousness will not be able to sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "This bedding is rattling in places. Just lying on the bed is noisy and noisy, so people with nervousness will not be able to sleep on it. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio che qua e là comincia a cedere. Basta stendercisi che scricchiola e fa baccano, e chi ha il sonno delicato non riuscirà a dormirci. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t大の字に寝てもなお余りある寝具。急なお客が来た際に、皆纏めて寝かしつける時に便利である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t大の字に寝てもなお余りある寝具。急なお客が来た際に、皆纏めて寝かしつける時に便利である。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bedding is more than enough even if you sleep with arms and legs spread wide apart. It is useful when you have a sudden guest and you want to put everyone to bed together. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bedding is more than enough even if you sleep with arms and legs spread wide apart. It is useful when you have a sudden guest and you want to put everyone to bed together. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio dove ci si sdraia a gambe e braccia larghe e avanza ancora posto. Comodo quando arrivano ospiti all'improvviso e bisogna far dormire tutti insieme. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t衣服を収めることを専門とする箪笥。通常のものより若干幅広に作られており、季節別に収納できるようになっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t衣服を収めることを専門とする箪笥。通常のものより若干幅広に作られており、季節別に収納できるようになっている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A chest of drawers specializing in storing clothes. They are made slightly wider than normal ones and can be used to store different seasons. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A chest of drawers specializing in storing clothes. They are made slightly wider than normal ones and can be used to store different seasons. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una cassettiera che serve solo a riporre i vestiti. È fatta un po' più larga del solito, così da tenerli divisi per stagione. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた立派な机。より収納性を増しながらも、大きさは据え置きを保っている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t酒場に設置される為に作られた立派な机。より収納性を増しながらも、大きさは据え置きを保っている。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A magnificent desk made to be installed in a bar. It has more storage capacity, but keeps its size unchanged. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A magnificent desk made to be installed in a bar. It has more storage capacity, but keeps its size unchanged. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo di pregio, fatto apposta per stare in una taverna. Ci sta dentro più roba di prima, e intanto la misura è rimasta quella. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tお高い感じがする鏡台。女性達の憧れる家具の一つである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tお高い感じがする鏡台。女性達の憧れる家具の一つである。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A mirror stand that looks expensive. It is one of the most coveted pieces of furniture for women. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A mirror stand that looks expensive. It is one of the most coveted pieces of furniture for women. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Una toeletta che dà l'idea di costare parecchio. È uno dei mobili che le donne sognano. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\tいかにも高そうな素材で焼き上げられた花瓶。その表面は輝く程につやつやしている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tいかにも高そうな素材で焼き上げられた花瓶。その表面は輝く程につやつやしている。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Vase made of expensive-looking material. Its surface is so glossy that it shines. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Vase made of expensive-looking material. Its surface is so glossy that it shines. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un vaso cotto in un materiale che ha tutta l'aria di costare caro. La superficie è lucida al punto di brillare. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t質の高い素材を余すところなく使った格調高い寝具。その滑らかな感触はこれが美術品であるかのように錯覚させる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t質の高い素材を余すところなく使った格調高い寝具。その滑らかな感触はこれが美術品であるかのように錯覚させる。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: The bedding is of the highest quality and made of the finest materials. Its smooth feel gives the illusion that it is a work of art. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "The bedding is of the highest quality and made of the finest materials. Its smooth feel gives the illusion that it is a work of art. \n#~ Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un giaciglio di gran classe, fatto di materiali pregiati senza risparmiarne un filo. Al tatto è così liscio da far credere per un attimo di avere davanti un'opera d'arte. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t酒類を保管しておく為に作られた戸棚。こっそり取り出して飲むのは、楽しみに取っておいた人に物凄く恨まれる行為なので止めておこう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t酒類を保管しておく為に作られた戸棚。こっそり取り出して飲むのは、楽しみに取っておいた人に物凄く恨まれる行為なので止めておこう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A cupboard made for storing alcoholic beverages. Don't try to sneak out and drink from it, as it is an act that will cause terrible resentment from those who have saved it for their enjoyment. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A cupboard made for storing alcoholic beverages. Don't try to sneak out and drink from it, as it is an act that will cause terrible resentment from those who have saved it for their enjoyment. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un armadietto costruito per tenerci i liquori. Tirarne fuori una bottiglia di nascosto e berla fa odiare a morte da chi la teneva da parte per il piacere: meglio lasciar perdere. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t長年使いこまれ、多少ガタがきている机。それでも使い続けるのは、使い慣れているということもあるが、一重に愛着からだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t長年使いこまれ、多少ガタがきている机。それでも使い続けるのは、使い慣れているということもあるが、一重に愛着からだろう。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A desk that has been used for many years and is somewhat worn out. The reason why he continues to use the desk is not only because he is used to using it, but also because he is attached to it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A desk that has been used for many years and is somewhat worn out. The reason why he continues to use the desk is not only because he is used to using it, but also because he is attached to it. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo consumato da anni di uso, che qua e là comincia a cedere. Se lo si tiene lo stesso è anche perché ci si è abituati, ma soprattutto per affetto. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t吸水性に富んだ糸織物。柔軟剤は使っていない。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t吸水性に富んだ糸織物。柔軟剤は使っていない。\n#～パルミア秋冬物コレクション～\n"
en: Woven textile with high water absorbency. No fabric softener is used.\n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~
en_grezzo: "Woven textile with high water absorbency. No fabric softener is used.\n# ~Palmian Winter Fashion~"
it: Un tessuto di filo che assorbe molto bene l'acqua. Ammorbidente non ne ha visto.\n# ~Palmia: Collezione Autunno-Inverno~

jp: \t\t様々な装飾品を所狭しと詰め込んだ棚。絶妙なバランスで積み重なっているので、そこからアイテムを取り出すことはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な装飾品を所狭しと詰め込んだ棚。絶妙なバランスで積み重なっているので、そこからアイテムを取り出すことはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves crammed with various decorative items. The items are stacked in a perfect balance so that it is impossible to remove items from them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves crammed with various decorative items. The items are stacked in a perfect balance so that it is impossible to remove items from them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale stipato di ninnoli di ogni genere, che non ci sta più niente. Il mucchio sta su per un equilibrio così preciso che di lì non si può tirare fuori niente. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t様々な日用品を所狭しと詰め込んだ棚。絶妙なバランスで積み重なっているので、そこからアイテムを取り出すことはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な日用品を所狭しと詰め込んだ棚。絶妙なバランスで積み重なっているので、そこからアイテムを取り出すことはできない。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: Shelves crammed with various commodities. The items are stacked in a perfect balance so that it is impossible to remove items from them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "Shelves crammed with various commodities. The items are stacked in a perfect balance so that it is impossible to remove items from them. \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Uno scaffale stipato di roba di tutti i giorni, che non ci sta più niente. Il mucchio sta su per un equilibrio così preciso che di lì non si può tirare fuori niente. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t綺麗に磨かれ万事に備えられた武具。その全てに売約済と書かれているので、勝手に装備することはできない。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t綺麗に磨かれ万事に備えられた武具。その全てに売約済と書かれているので、勝手に装備することはできない。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Armor that has been beautifully polished and prepared for all eventualities. All of them are marked as sold, so you cannot equip them without permission. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Armor that has been beautifully polished and prepared for all eventualities. All of them are marked as sold, so you cannot equip them without permission. \n# ~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: Un'armatura lucidata a dovere e pronta a ogni evenienza. Su ogni pezzo c'è scritto che è già venduto, e perciò non la si può indossare di propria iniziativa. \n# ~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t謎めいた雰囲気を持つ地図。意味深であるだけで、特に目立った効果は持っていないという。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t謎めいた雰囲気を持つ地図。意味深であるだけで、特に目立った効果は持っていないという。\n#～今日から君も冒険者・旅用マニュアル～\n"
en: The map has an enigmatic atmosphere. It is said to have no particular remarkable effect, just a sense of significance. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~
en_grezzo: "The map has an enigmatic atmosphere. It is said to have no particular remarkable effect, just a sense of significance. \n# ~an Adventurer is You! Guide for Travels~"
it: Una mappa che si porta addosso un'aria di mistero. Ha solo quell'aria, dicono: un effetto degno di nota non ce l'ha. \n# ~Da Oggi Avventuriero Anche Tu: Manuale di Viaggio~

jp: \t\t泳げない者が主に使用する浮力を増す為の用具。ポート・カプールにおいて町の子供がしばしば使用しているのが見受けられる。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t泳げない者が主に使用する浮力を増す為の用具。ポート・カプールにおいて町の子供がしばしば使用しているのが見受けられる。\n#～家庭を彩る日用雑貨～\n"
en: Buoyancy aid mainly used by non-swimmers to increase their buoyancy. Often seen used by town children in Port Kapul swimming pools. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~
en_grezzo: "Buoyancy aid mainly used by non-swimmers to increase their buoyancy. Often seen used by town children in Port Kapul swimming pools. \n# ~Daily Necessities for the Home~"
it: Un attrezzo che aumenta il galleggiamento, usato soprattutto da chi non sa nuotare. A Porto Kapul capita spesso di vederlo addosso ai bambini del posto. \n# ~Casalinghi che Danno Colore alla Casa~

jp: \t\t温かみのある円形のテーブル。椅子を使わずに使用したくなったり、手をかけてテーブルをひっくり返したくなったりするのは、一体どういう訳なのだろうか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t温かみのある円形のテーブル。椅子を使わずに使用したくなったり、手をかけてテーブルをひっくり返したくなったりするのは、一体どういう訳なのだろうか。\n#～ノースティリス大家具事典～\n"
en: A warm, circular table. What is it about it that makes you want to use it without chairs or flip the table over with your hands? \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~
en_grezzo: "A warm, circular table. What is it about it that makes you want to use it without chairs or flip the table over with your hands? \n# ~Great Encyclopedia of North Tyris Furnitures~"
it: Un tavolo rotondo che ha qualcosa di caldo. Come mai viene voglia di usarlo senza sedie, o di prenderlo per il bordo e rovesciarlo? Chi lo sa. \n# ~Grande Enciclopedia dei Mobili di Tyris del Nord~

jp: \t\t水が並々張られたとても重い用具。主に家畜用の物なので、さしもの冒険者もこれには手をつけないらしい。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t水が並々張られたとても重い用具。主に家畜用の物なので、さしもの冒険者もこれには手をつけないらしい。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: A very heavy container filled with water. Since it is mainly used for livestock, even the most adventurous of adventurers are not likely to touch it. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "A very heavy container filled with water. Since it is mainly used for livestock, even the most adventurous of adventurers are not likely to touch it. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: Un attrezzo pesantissimo, colmo d'acqua fino all'orlo. Serve soprattutto per il bestiame, e pare che nemmeno l'avventuriero più intraprendente ci metta le mani. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

en: \"Not suitable for golems\" \n# ~a Mysterious Note~
en_grezzo: "\"Not suitable for golems\" \n# ~a Mysterious Note~"
it: \"Non adatto ai golem\" \n# ~un appunto misterioso~

jp: \t\tそれは第二の月明かり。彼らはいつでも休むことなく道行く人々に影を作っているのだ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tそれは第二の月明かり。彼らはいつでも休むことなく道行く人々に影を作っているのだ。\n#～街中の名脇役達～\n"
en: It is the second moonlight. They are always creating shadows for the people on the street without a break. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~
en_grezzo: "It is the second moonlight. They are always creating shadows for the people on the street without a break. \n# ~Supporting Roles on the Streets~"
it: È il secondo chiaro di luna. Loro, senza mai riposare, disegnano l'ombra della gente che passa per la strada. \n# ~I Grandi Comprimari della Città~

jp: \t\t何らかの理由により根元から折れてしまった、とても重い柱だ。その独自の形は、どことなく芸術性を感じる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t何らかの理由により根元から折れてしまった、とても重い柱だ。その独自の形は、どことなく芸術性を感じる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A very heavy pillar, broken from the base for some reason. Its unique shape is somehow artistic. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A very heavy pillar, broken from the base for some reason. Its unique shape is somehow artistic. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una colonna pesantissima, spezzata alla base per chissà quale ragione. Quella forma che è solo sua ha, chissà come, qualcosa d'arte. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t天へ真っすぐ伸びた、雄々しく、とても重い柱だ。微動だにしないその姿は、大地の神を思い起こさせる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t天へ真っすぐ伸びた、雄々しく、とても重い柱だ。微動だにしないその姿は、大地の神を思い起こさせる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Majestic and very heavy, it is a pillar that stretches straight up to the sky. Its motionless form reminds us of the God of Earth. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Majestic and very heavy, it is a pillar that stretches straight up to the sky. Its motionless form reminds us of the God of Earth. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una colonna pesantissima e fiera, che sale dritta verso il cielo. Quella figura che non si muove di un capello fa venire in mente il dio della terra. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~
